scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:rust
scripts.ship:api:dev: npm run ship:check && cd apps/api && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env dev && npx wrangler deploy --env dev
scripts.ship:api:prod: npm run ship:check && cd apps/api && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production && npx wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.ship:app: npm run ship:check && node scripts/require-env.mjs VITE_API_URL && cd apps/desktop && npm run tauri build
